references.text: Jesus sees the crowd and feels compassion for them because they are like sheep without a shepherd, which is similar to how Jesus felt compassion for the crowd in Mark 6:34.
All of us who have gone astray like sheep, reflecting the image of people as sheep without a shepherd in Mark 6:34.
The Lord is my shepherd; I lack nothing, contrasting with the condition of the crowd in Mark 6:34 who are like sheep without a shepherd.
Know your sheep well, suggesting the importance of having a shepherd, in contrast to the crowd in Mark 6:34 who lack one.
Jesus describes himself as the good shepherd who gives his life for the sheep, which adds deeper meaning to his compassion for the crowd in Mark 6:34.
